item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Victoria Justice all songs FLAC, M4A, WAV
item.description:
Victoria Justice – FLAC / Lossless Collection Request

Hi everyone!

I was wondering if anyone could share a complete collection of Victoria Justice’s songs and music released up to now, preferably in FLAC or any other lossless format.

I’ve been looking around the forum, but unfortunately, most of the links for Victoria Justice releases are already dead, so I would really appreciate it if someone could help by sharing whatever they have available.

Ideally, I’d love to get everything available up to the present day, including official releases, singles, soundtrack songs, collaborations, and any other officially released tracks.

If you have them in FLAC, ALAC, WAV, or another lossless format, that would be amazing. Even if you only have part of the discography, I’d be very grateful for anything you can share.

Thank you so much in advance to anyone who can help! ❤️
I really appreciate the time and effort that goes into preserving and sharing these releases.
